content_html:
An agent-first CLI for Proton Mail. Schema manifest for tool use, NDJSON on stdout, typed error envelopes, and a stable exit-code enum — designed to be driven by a language model, not a human.

Unofficial project. higgs is an independent, community-built CLI for Proton Mail. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Proton AG. "Proton", "Proton Mail", and related marks are trademarks of Proton AG; this project uses them only to describe interoperability.

Why this exists

Wiring a normal CLI into an agent loop is painful. Stdout mixes prose and data, errors are English sentences, exit codes are 0-or-1, and the only tool specification is --help. higgs inverts that. Every design decision assumes the primary caller is a model:

  • Schema manifest. higgs schema emits a JSON description of every subcommand — flags, args, stdout format, exit codes. An agent loads it once and can drive the tool without prompt-engineered command syntax.
  • NDJSON streaming with a terminator. Every streaming command emits one JSON object per line and ends with {"type":"summary", ...}. Callers know when a stream is done without heuristics.
  • Typed error envelopes. Every failure emits {"error": {"kind", "code", "reason", "message", "hint"}}. Agents branch on .error.kind, not on parsed English.
  • Exit codes as an enum. Exit codes map 1:1 to error kinds, so retry and escalation are deterministic: retry on 5 imap, prompt the user on 2 auth, surface to the caller on 4 config.
  • Sanitized stderr. Human-readable progress on stderr, stripped of ANSI escapes, bidi controls, and zero-width characters — safe to feed back into a model's context.
  • Checkpointed state. SQLite state DB with backfill and state clear so runs are resumable across crashes and restarts.
  • Secrets out-of-band. Credentials go to the OS keyring (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, libsecret on Linux) with an AES-256-GCM file fallback, so nothing sensitive flows through an agent's context. The first workload riding this contract is a local-only Proton Mail inbox classifier via Proton Mail Bridge and Ollama. The classifier is useful on its own, but the contract is the point.

The classifier

higgs classify connects to a running Proton Mail Bridge over IMAP, streams each message through a local LLM (Ollama by default, or any self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server such as llama.cpp llama-server — see PM_LLM_BACKEND), and applies one or more labels from an 11-category taxonomy. Every step runs on localhost: no API keys, no cloud inference, no telemetry.

The default model is Gemma 4, chosen because it has native function-calling support, a 128K context window on the small variants, and fits comfortably on a laptop.

Quickstart

  1. Install and sign into Proton Mail Bridge. Note the IMAP username and bridge password it assigns.

  2. Install Ollama and pull a model:

    ollama pull gemma4

  3. Install higgs:

    # Homebrew (macOS & Linux)
brew tap higgscli/higgs
brew install higgs

# go install
go install github.com/higgscli/higgs/cmd/higgs@latest

    Or build from source:

    git clone https://github.com/higgscli/higgs.git
cd higgs
make build

  4. Export Bridge and Ollama settings. A .env at the repo root works:

    export PM_IMAP_USERNAME="alice@proton.me"
export PM_IMAP_PASSWORD="bridge-generated-password"
export PM_IMAP_HOST="127.0.0.1"
export PM_IMAP_PORT="1143"
export PM_OLLAMA_MODEL="gemma4"

  5. Dry-run against your inbox:

    higgs classify --dry-run --limit 20 INBOX

    Review the NDJSON. When the suggestions look right, rerun with --apply to write labels back to Proton.

The agent contract

Schema manifest

higgs schema returns a manifest of every subcommand. Load it once, drive the CLI from it.

higgs schema classify

{
  "name": "classify",
  "summary": "Classify messages with Ollama and optionally apply labels",
  "args": [{"name": "mailbox", "required": false, "default": "INBOX"}],
  "flags": [
    {"name": "dry-run", "type": "bool", "description": "Preview suggestions without writing labels"},
    {"name": "apply", "type": "bool", "description": "Apply suggested labels to IMAP"},
    {"name": "limit", "type": "int", "default": 100},
    {"name": "workers", "type": "int", "default": 4},
    {"name": "no-state", "type": "bool"},
    {"name": "reprocess", "type": "bool"}
  ],
  "stdout": "ndjson",
  "exit_codes": [0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9]
}

Output contract

  • stdout: structured JSON. Single-object commands pretty-print; streaming commands emit NDJSON.
  • stderr: human-readable progress, sanitized of ANSI escapes, bidi controls, and zero-width characters.
  • NDJSON terminator: every streaming command ends with one {"type":"summary", ...} line. Read until you see it.
  • Error envelope: failures emit a typed envelope with kind, code, reason, message, and hint.
{
  "error": {
    "kind": "config",
    "code": 400,
    "reason": "configError",
    "message": "PM_IMAP_USERNAME is required",
    "hint": "export PM_IMAP_USERNAME=<bridge-username>"
  }
}

Exit codes

Code Kind Description
0 success Command completed without error
1 api Upstream API error (generic)
2 auth Authentication or credential failure
3 validation Invalid flags, arguments, or input
4 config Missing or malformed configuration
5 imap IMAP protocol or connection error
6 classify Classification error (Ollama, prompt, parsing)
7 state State DB error (SQLite)
8 discovery Mailbox discovery failure
9 internal Unexpected internal error

Commands

The intended flow is: discover mailboxes, classify them, apply labels. Everything else (backfill, cleanup-labels, state, verify) exists to repair or inspect state along the way.

Commands compose over pipes: every command that accepts an explicit --uid list also accepts --uid -, which reads the UID set from stdin. Stdin may be plain UIDs (comma- or whitespace-separated) or NDJSON, from which each row's numeric uid field is taken (rows without one, like summary lines, are skipped). So any command's NDJSON output is directly usable as another's input:

higgs search INBOX --before 2025-07-01 | higgs archive INBOX --uid -
higgs state query INBOX --is-mailing-list false | higgs move INBOX Folders/Personal --uid -

scan-folders

Enumerate IMAP mailboxes and return the canonical All Mail and Labels roots.

higgs scan-folders

{
  "mailboxes": [
    {"name": "INBOX", "delimiter": "/", "messages": 1204, "unseen": 18, "attributes": []},
    {"name": "Labels/Orders", "delimiter": "/", "attributes": ["\\HasNoChildren"]}
  ],
  "all_mail": "All Mail",
  "labels_root": "Labels"
}

classify

Stream messages through Ollama and emit one NDJSON object per message, followed by a summary terminator. Add --apply to write labels back to IMAP in the same pass.

higgs classify --dry-run --limit 20 INBOX
higgs classify --apply --workers 4 "Folders/Accounts"
higgs classify --reprocess --no-state INBOX

Flags: --dry-run, --apply, --limit N, --no-state, --reprocess, --workers N.

{"mailbox":"INBOX","uid":1842,"uid_validity":1,"subject":"Your order has shipped","from":"ship-confirm@amazon.com","date":"2026-04-09T14:22:10Z","suggested_labels":["Orders"],"confidence":0.94,"rationale":"Shipping notification with tracking number","is_mailing_list":false}
{"type":"summary","mailbox":"INBOX","classified":20,"errors":0,"skipped":0}

apply-labels

Apply pending labels recorded in the state DB. Use when classify ran without --apply.

higgs apply-labels --limit 100 "Folders/Accounts"
higgs apply-labels --dry-run "Folders/Accounts"

cleanup-labels

Consolidate legacy or user-created labels into the canonical 11-label taxonomy. Useful after migrating from Proton's built-in filters.

higgs cleanup-labels --dry-run
higgs cleanup-labels

fetch-and-parse

Fetch and parse messages without classifying. Useful for piping into other tools.

higgs fetch-and-parse INBOX | jq 'select(.from | contains("github"))'

backfill

Replay a prior classify NDJSON log into the state DB. Recovers state after a crash or migration.

higgs backfill classify.log

state

Inspect or reset the SQLite state DB.

higgs state stats
higgs state stats "Folders/Accounts"
higgs state clear "Folders/Accounts"

state query exposes the per-message classification records classify persists (labels, confidence, rationale, mailing-list flag), so results stay queryable after the fact — no re-parsing saved NDJSON. It is purely local (no IMAP connection) and streams NDJSON rows whose uid fields pipe straight into --uid - consumers.

higgs state query INBOX --is-mailing-list false
higgs state query INBOX --label Personal --min-confidence 0.8
higgs state query --failed

Flags: --is-mailing-list true|false, --applied true|false, --min-confidence F, --max-confidence F, --label X (exact element match), --failed, --limit N.

verify

Audit a mailbox against an expected UID set without mutating anything. --expect present (default) requires every given UID to exist, --expect absent requires none to, and --expect exact requires the mailbox's UID set to equal the given set. Violations stream as NDJSON rows and make the command exit non-zero.

higgs verify Archive --uid 1842,1843
higgs search INBOX --before 2025-07-01 | higgs verify INBOX --uid - --expect absent

schema

Emit a machine-readable manifest of every subcommand. See The agent contract.

higgs schema
higgs schema classify

Configuration

All configuration is read from environment variables. Defaults target a standard Proton Mail Bridge + Ollama setup on the same host.

Credentials

Credentials are stored in the OS keyring (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Linux Secret Service via libsecret) so they never live in shell history or a .env file. When the keyring is unreachable, an encrypted-file fallback (~/.higgs/credentials.enc, AES-256-GCM with Argon2id-derived keys) is available.

# Prompt interactively and store via the OS keyring (default).
higgs auth login
 
# Pipe the password in from a secret manager:
pass show proton/bridge | higgs auth login --username alice@proton.me --password-stdin
 
# Check where credentials live and which backends are available.
higgs auth status
 
# Remove stored credentials from every backend.
higgs auth logout

If PM_IMAP_USERNAME and/or PM_IMAP_PASSWORD are set in the environment they always win — useful for one-off overrides in CI or shells. To use the encrypted-file backend, export PM_KEYSTORE_PASSPHRASE (required to read or write the file) and optionally PM_KEYSTORE_PATH to relocate it.

IMAP (Proton Mail Bridge)

Variable Default Description
PM_IMAP_HOST 127.0.0.1 Bridge host
PM_IMAP_PORT 1143 Bridge IMAP port
PM_IMAP_USERNAME (required) Bridge IMAP username
PM_IMAP_PASSWORD (required) Bridge-generated password
PM_IMAP_SECURITY starttls One of starttls, tls, insecure
PM_IMAP_TLS_SKIP_VERIFY auto Skip TLS verification (auto-enabled for loopback)
PM_IMAP_APPLY_TIMEOUT 180 Per-command timeout (seconds) for --apply

LLM backend

Variable Default Description
PM_LLM_BACKEND ollama Chat backend: ollama or openai

Everything stays local either way: openai means the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API served by self-hosted engines like llama.cpp llama-server — not the OpenAI cloud.

Ollama (PM_LLM_BACKEND=ollama, default)

Variable Default Description
PM_OLLAMA_BASE_URL http://localhost:11434 Ollama API base URL
PM_OLLAMA_MODEL gemma4 Model name passed to Ollama

OpenAI-compatible (PM_LLM_BACKEND=openai)

Variable Default Description
PM_OPENAI_BASE_URL (required) Server base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (llama.cpp llama-server)
PM_OPENAI_MODEL (required) Model name/alias the server expects
PM_OPENAI_API_KEY (none) Optional bearer token; sent only when set

Reasoning models (e.g. Qwen3) are handled automatically: thinking is disabled for structured calls (classify, extract, digest), enabled for ask and summarize, and any <think> preamble is stripped before parsing. Structured output uses response_format: json_schema. Example:

PM_LLM_BACKEND=openai \
PM_OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080 \
PM_OPENAI_MODEL=qwen3.6-35b-a3b \
higgs classify INBOX --limit 20 --dry-run

Classify tuning

Variable Default Description
PM_CLASSIFY_LIMIT 100 Max messages per classify run
PM_CLASSIFY_BATCH_SIZE 25 IMAP fetch batch size
PM_CLASSIFY_WORKERS 4 Parallel LLM requests (llama-server serializes unless started with --parallel N)

State

Variable Default Description
PM_STATE_DB ~/.higgs/state.db SQLite state DB path

Label taxonomy

The classifier is constrained to 11 canonical labels. 612 aliases in internal/labels/data/labels.toml normalize legacy or model-generated names back to this set.

Label Covers
Orders Purchase confirmations, shipping, returns
Finance Banks, cards, taxes, invoices
Newsletters Editorial digests, blog mailings
Promotions Marketing, discounts, sales
Jobs Recruiters, job boards, offers
Social Social network notifications, friend activity
Services SaaS account activity, product updates
Health Providers, pharmacy, insurance
Travel Flights, hotels, itineraries
Security 2FA, password resets, security alerts
Signups Account creation, email verification

See internal/labels/data/labels.toml for the full alias map.

Development

Every common task is wrapped in the repo Makefile.

Target Description
make build Build the ./bin/higgs binary
make test Run go test ./...
make test-race Run tests with the race detector
make cover Coverage profile plus go tool cover -func summary
make cover-html HTML coverage report at coverage.html
make vet Run go vet ./...
make vuln Run govulncheck (installs into ./bin if missing)
make check vet + test-race + vuln
make clean Remove the built binary and coverage outputs
make tidy Run go mod tidy

Run make check before opening a PR.

Contributing

Bug reports and pull requests are welcome — see CONTRIBUTING.md for the workflow and code-review expectations.

Security

Please report vulnerabilities privately via the process in SECURITY.md. Do not open public issues for security reports.

License

Apache License 2.0 — see LICENSE.

Acknowledgements

  • Proton Mail Bridge — local IMAP gateway to Proton Mail
  • Ollama — local LLM runtime
  • emersion/go-imap — IMAP client library
  • spf13/cobra — CLI framework
  • BurntSushi/toml — TOML decoder for the label taxonomy

blocks.html_en: Wiring a normal CLI into an agent loop is painful. Stdout mixes prose and data, errors are English sentences, exit codes are 0-or-1, and the only tool specification is --help. higgs inverts that. Every design decision assumes the primary caller is a model:

sentences.en: Wiring a normal CLI into an agent loop is painful.
sentences.zh: 将普通的 CLI 连接到代理循环中是很痛苦的。

sentences.en: Stdout mixes prose and data, errors are English sentences, exit codes are 0-or-1, and the only tool specification is --help.
sentences.zh: Stdout 混合了散文和数据，错误是英文句子，退出代码是 0 或 1，唯一的工具规范是 --help。
希格斯粒子颠倒了这一点。

sentences.en: Every design decision assumes the primary caller is a model:
sentences.zh: 每个设计决策都假设主要调用者是一个模型：

blocks.html_en: • Schema manifest. higgs schema emits a JSON description of every subcommand — flags, args, stdout format, exit codes. An agent loads it once and can drive the tool without prompt-engineered command syntax.

sentences.en: higgs schema emits a JSON description of every subcommand — flags, args, stdout format, exit codes.
sentences.zh: higgs 模式发出每个子命令的 JSON 描述 — 标志、参数、标准输出格式、退出代码。

sentences.en: An agent loads it once and can drive the tool without prompt-engineered command syntax.
sentences.zh: 代理加载一次即可驱动该工具，而无需提示设计的命令语法。

blocks.html_en: • NDJSON streaming with a terminator. Every streaming command emits one JSON object per line and ends with {"type":"summary", ...}. Callers know when a stream is done without heuristics.

sentences.zh: 带有终止符的 NDJSON 流式传输。

sentences.en: Every streaming command emits one JSON object per line and ends with {"type":"summary", ...}.
sentences.zh: 每个流命令每行发出一个 JSON 对象，并以 {"type":"summary", ...} 结尾。

sentences.en: Callers know when a stream is done without heuristics.
sentences.zh: 调用者无需启发式即可知道流何时完成。

blocks.html_en: • Typed error envelopes. Every failure emits {"error": {"kind", "code", "reason", "message", "hint"}}. Agents branch on .error.kind, not on parsed English.

sentences.en: Agents branch on .error.kind, not on parsed English.
sentences.zh: 代理在 .error.kind 上分支，而不是在解析的英语上分支。

blocks.html_en: • Exit codes as an enum. Exit codes map 1:1 to error kinds, so retry and escalation are deterministic: retry on 5 imap, prompt the user on 2 auth, surface to the caller on 4 config.

sentences.en: Exit codes map 1:1 to error kinds, so retry and escalation are deterministic: retry on 5 imap, prompt the user on 2 auth, surface to the caller on 4 config.
sentences.zh: 退出代码将 1:1 映射到错误类型，因此重试和升级是确定性的：在 5 imap 上重试，在 2 auth 上提示用户，在 4 config 上向调用者显示。

blocks.html_en: • Sanitized stderr. Human-readable progress on stderr, stripped of ANSI escapes, bidi controls, and zero-width characters — safe to feed back into a model's context.

sentences.en: Human-readable progress on stderr, stripped of ANSI escapes, bidi controls, and zero-width characters — safe to feed back into a model's context.
sentences.zh: stderr 上人类可读的进展，剥离了 ANSI 转义、双向控件和零宽度字符 - 可以安全地反馈到模型的上下文中。

blocks.html_en: • Checkpointed state. SQLite state DB with backfill and state clear so runs are resumable across crashes and restarts.

sentences.en: SQLite state DB with backfill and state clear so runs are resumable across crashes and restarts.
sentences.zh: SQLite 状态数据库具有回填和状态清除功能，因此在崩溃和重新启动时可以恢复运行。

blocks.html_en: • Secrets out-of-band. Credentials go to the OS keyring (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, libsecret on Linux) with an AES-256-GCM file fallback, so nothing sensitive flows through an agent's context. The first workload riding this contract is a local-only Proton Mail inbox classifier via Proton Mail Bridge and Ollama. The classifier is useful on its own, but the contract is the point.

sentences.en: Credentials go to the OS keyring (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, libsecret on Linux) with an AES-256-GCM file fallback, so nothing sensitive flows through an agent's context.
sentences.zh: 凭证通过 AES-256-GCM 文件后备进入操作系统密钥环（macOS 钥匙串、Windows 凭证管理器、Linux 上的 libsecret），因此没有任何敏感信息流过代理的上下文。

sentences.en: The first workload riding this contract is a local-only Proton Mail inbox classifier via Proton Mail Bridge and Ollama.
sentences.zh: 该合同的第一个工作负载是通过 Proton Mail Bridge 和 Ollama 实现本地专用的 Proton Mail 收件箱分类器。

sentences.en: The classifier is useful on its own, but the contract is the point.
sentences.zh: 分类器本身很有用，但契约才是重点。

blocks.html_en: higgs classify connects to a running Proton Mail Bridge over IMAP, streams each message through a local LLM (Ollama by default, or any self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server such as llama.cpp llama-server — see PM_LLM_BACKEND), and applies one or more labels from an 11-category taxonomy. Every step runs on localhost: no API keys, no cloud inference, no telemetry.

content_html_zh:
Proton Mail 的代理优先 CLI。 用于工具使用的架构清单、标准输出上的 NDJSON、类型化错误信封和稳定的退出代码枚举 - 设计为由语言模型驱动，而不是由人类驱动。

非官方项目。 higgs 是一个独立的、社区构建的 Proton Mail CLI。 它不隶属于 Proton AG，也不受其认可或赞助。 “Proton”、“Proton Mail”和相关标志是 Proton AG 的商标；该项目仅使用它们来描述互操作性。

为什么存在这个

将普通的 CLI 连接到代理循环中是很痛苦的。 Stdout 混合了散文和数据，错误是英文句子，退出代码是 0 或 1，唯一的工具规范是 --help。 希格斯粒子颠倒了这一点。 每个设计决策都假设主要调用者是一个模型：

  • 架构清单。 higgs 模式发出每个子命令的 JSON 描述 — 标志、参数、标准输出格式、退出代码。 代理加载一次即可驱动该工具，而无需提示设计的命令语法。
  • 带有终止符的 NDJSON 流式传输。 每个流命令每行发出一个 JSON 对象，并以 {"type":"summary", ...} 结尾。 调用者无需启发式即可知道流何时完成。
  • 输入的错误信封。 每次失败都会发出 {"error": {"kind", "code", "reason", "message", "hint"}}。 代理在 .error.kind 上分支，而不是在解析的英语上分支。
  • 退出代码作为枚举。 退出代码将 1:1 映射到错误类型，因此重试和升级是确定性的：在 5 imap 上重试，在 2 auth 上提示用户，在 4 config 上向调用者显示。
  • 已消毒标准错误。 stderr 上人类可读的进展，剥离了 ANSI 转义、双向控件和零宽度字符 - 可以安全地反馈到模型的上下文中。
  • 检查点状态。 SQLite 状态数据库具有回填和状态清除功能，因此在崩溃和重新启动时可以恢复运行。
  • 带外秘密。 凭证通过 AES-256-GCM 文件后备进入操作系统密钥环（macOS 钥匙串、Windows 凭证管理器、Linux 上的 libsecret），因此没有任何敏感信息流过代理的上下文。 该合同的第一个工作负载是通过 Proton Mail Bridge 和 Ollama 实现本地专用的 Proton Mail 收件箱分类器。 分类器本身很有用，但契约才是重点。

分类器

higgs分类通过IMAP连接到正在运行的Proton Mail Bridge，通过本地LLM（默认为Ollama，或任何自托管的OpenAI兼容服务器，例如llama.cpp llama-server - 请参阅PM_LLM_BACKEND）流式传输每条消息，并应用11类分类中的一个或多个标签。 每个步骤都在本地主机上运行：没有 API 密钥、没有云推理、没有遥测。

默认模型是 Gemma 4，选择它是因为它具有本机函数调用支持、小型变体上的 128K 上下文窗口，并且适合笔记本电脑。

快速入门

  1. 安装并登录 Proton Mail Bridge。 记下它分配的 IMAP 用户名和网桥密码。
  2. 安装 Ollama 并拉取模型：ollama pull gemma4
  3. 安装 higgs: # Homebrew (macOS & Linux) brew tap higgscli/higgs brew install higgs # go install go install github.com/higgscli/higgs/cmd/higgs@latest 或者从源代码构建： git clone https://github.com/higgscli/higgs.git cd higgs make build
  4. 导出 Bridge 和 Ollama 设置。 仓库根目录下的 .env 有效： export PM_IMAP_USERNAME="alice@proton.me" export PM_IMAP_PASSWORD="bridge- generated-password" export PM_IMAP_HOST="127.0.0.1" export PM_IMAP_PORT="1143" export PM_OLLAMA_MODEL="gemma4"
  5. 针对您的收件箱进行试运行： higgs Classify --dry-run --limit 20 INBOX 查看 NDJSON。 当建议看起来正确时，使用 --apply 重新运行以将标签写回 Proton。

代理合同

模式清单

higgs 模式返回每个子命令的清单。 加载一次，然后从中驱动 CLI。

higgs schema classify

{
  "name": "classify",
  "summary": "Classify messages with Ollama and optionally apply labels",
  "args": [{"name": "mailbox", "required": false, "default": "INBOX"}],
  "flags": [
    {"name": "dry-run", "type": "bool", "description": "Preview suggestions without writing labels"},
    {"name": "apply", "type": "bool", "description": "Apply suggested labels to IMAP"},
    {"name": "limit", "type": "int", "default": 100},
    {"name": "workers", "type": "int", "default": 4},
    {"name": "no-state", "type": "bool"},
    {"name": "reprocess", "type": "bool"}
  ],
  "stdout": "ndjson",
  "exit_codes": [0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9]
}

产出合约

  • 标准输出：结构化 JSON。 单对象命令漂亮打印；流命令发出 NDJSON。
  • stderr：人类可读的进度，已清理 ANSI 转义、双向控件和零宽度字符。
  • NDJSON 终止符：每个流命令以一个 {"type":"summary", ...} 行结束。 阅读直到你看到为止。
  • 错误信封：失败会发出带有类型、代码、原因、消息和提示的类型信封。
{
  "error": {
    "kind": "config",
    "code": 400,
    "reason": "configError",
    "message": "PM_IMAP_USERNAME is required",
    "hint": "export PM_IMAP_USERNAME=<bridge-username>"
  }
}

退出代码

Code Kind 描述
0 成功 命令已完成且没有错误
1 api 上游 API 错误（一般）
2 auth 身份验证或凭据失败
3 验证 无效的标志、参数或输入
4 配置 配置丢失或格式错误
5 imap IMAP 协议或连接错误
6 分类 分类错误（Ollama、提示、解析）
7 state 状态数据库错误 (SQLite)
8 发现 邮箱发现失败
9 内部的 意外的内部错误

命令

预期流程是：发现邮​​箱、对其进行分类、应用标签。 其他一切（回填、清理标签、状态、验证）都是为了修复或检查状态而存在的。

命令通过管道组成：每个接受显式 --uid 列表的命令也接受 --uid -，它从 stdin 读取 UID 集。 标准输入可以是纯 UID（以逗号或空格分隔）或 NDJSON，从中获取每一行的数字 uid 字段（没有 UID 的行，如摘要行，将被跳过）。 因此任何命令的 NDJSON 输出都可以直接用作另一个命令的输入：

higgs search INBOX --before 2025-07-01 | higgs archive INBOX --uid -
higgs state query INBOX --is-mailing-list false | higgs move INBOX Folders/Personal --uid -

扫描文件夹

枚举 IMAP 邮箱并返回规范的所有邮件和标签根。

higgs scan-folders

{
  "mailboxes": [
    {"name": "INBOX", "delimiter": "/", "messages": 1204, "unseen": 18, "attributes": []},
    {"name": "Labels/Orders", "delimiter": "/", "attributes": ["\\HasNoChildren"]}
  ],
  "all_mail": "All Mail",
  "labels_root": "Labels"
}

分类

通过 Ollama 流式传输消息，并为每条消息发出一个 NDJSON 对象，后跟一个摘要终止符。 添加 --apply 以在同一通道中将标签写回 IMAP。

higgs classify --dry-run --limit 20 INBOX
higgs classify --apply --workers 4 "Folders/Accounts"
higgs classify --reprocess --no-state INBOX

标志：--dry-run、--apply、--limit N、--no-state、--reprocess、--workers N。

{"mailbox":"INBOX","uid":1842,"uid_validity":1,"subject":"Your order has shipped","from":"ship-confirm@amazon.com","date":"2026-04-09T14:22:10Z","suggested_labels":["Orders"],"confidence":0.94,"rationale":"Shipping notification with tracking number","is_mailing_list":false}
{"type":"summary","mailbox":"INBOX","classified":20,"errors":0,"skipped":0}

应用标签

应用状态数据库中记录的待处理标签。 当分类运行时不使用 --apply 时使用。

higgs apply-labels --limit 100 "Folders/Accounts"
higgs apply-labels --dry-run "Folders/Accounts"

清理标签

将旧标签或用户创建的标签合并到规范的 11 标签分类法中。 从 Proton 的内置过滤器迁移后很有用。

higgs cleanup-labels --dry-run
higgs cleanup-labels

获取并解析

获取并解析消息而不进行分类。 对于通过管道连接到其他工具很有用。

higgs fetch-and-parse INBOX | jq 'select(.from | contains("github"))'

回填

将先前分类的 NDJSON 日志重播到状态数据库中。 在崩溃或迁移后恢复状态。

higgs backfill classify.log

state

检查或重置 SQLite 状态数据库。

higgs state stats
higgs state stats "Folders/Accounts"
higgs state clear "Folders/Accounts"

状态查询公开了每条消息的分类记录，分类仍然存在（标签、置信度、基本原理、邮件列表标志），因此结果在事后保持可查询性 — 无需重新解析保存的 NDJSON。 它是纯本地的（无 IMAP 连接），并流式传输 NDJSON 行，其 uid 字段直接通过管道传输到 --uid - 消费者。

higgs state query INBOX --is-mailing-list false
higgs state query INBOX --label Personal --min-confidence 0.8
higgs state query --failed

标志：--is-mailing-list true | false，--applied true | false，--min-confidence F，--max-confidence F，--label X（精确元素匹配），--failed，--limit N。

核实

根据预期的 UID 集审核邮箱，而不改变任何内容。 --expectpresent（默认）要求每个给定的 UID 都存在，--expectabsent 要求不存在，而 --expectexact 要求邮箱的 UID 设置等于给定的设置。 违规行为以 NDJSON 行形式传输，并使命令退出非零。

higgs verify Archive --uid 1842,1843
higgs search INBOX --before 2025-07-01 | higgs verify INBOX --uid - --expect absent

图式

发出每个子命令的机器可读清单。 参见代理合同。

higgs schema
higgs schema classify

配置

所有配置都是从环境变量中读取的。 默认目标是同一主机上的标准 Proton Mail Bridge + Ollama 设置。

证书

凭证存储在操作系统密钥环（macOS 钥匙串、Windows 凭证管理器、通过 libsecret 的 Linux Secret Service）中，因此它们永远不会存在于 shell 历史记录或 .env 文件中。 当密钥环无法访问时，可以使用加密文件后备（~/.higgs/credentials.enc、带有 Argon2id 派生密钥的 AES-256-GCM）。

# Prompt interactively and store via the OS keyring (default).
higgs auth login
 
# Pipe the password in from a secret manager:
pass show proton/bridge | higgs auth login --username alice@proton.me --password-stdin
 
# Check where credentials live and which backends are available.
higgs auth status
 
# Remove stored credentials from every backend.
higgs auth logout

如果在环境中设置了 PM_IMAP_USERNAME 和/或 PM_IMAP_PASSWORD，它们总是会获胜——对于 CI 或 shell 中的一次性覆盖很有用。 要使用加密文件后端，请导出 PM_KEYSTORE_PASSPHRASE（读取或写入文件所需），并可选择导出 PM_KEYSTORE_PATH 来重新定位它。

IMAP（质子邮件桥）

多变的 默认 描述
PM_IMAP_HOST 127.0.0.1 桥接主机
PM_IMAP_PORT 1143 桥接 IMAP 端口
PM_IMAP_USERNAME （必需的） 桥接 IMAP 用户名

法学硕士后端

多变的 默认 描述
PM_LLM_BACKEND 成为 聊天后端：ollama 或 openai

无论哪种方式，一切都保持在本地：openai 是指由 llama.cpp llama-server 等自托管引擎提供的与 OpenAI 兼容的聊天完成 API，而不是 OpenAI 云。

Ollama（PM_LLM_BACKEND=ollama，默认）

多变的 默认 描述
PM_OLLAMA_BASE_URL http://本地主机:11434 Ollama API 基本 URL

OpenAI 兼容 (PM_LLM_BACKEND=openai)

多变的 默认 描述

PM_OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080 \
PM_OPENAI_MODEL=qwen3.6-35b-a3b \
higgs classify INBOX --limit 20 --dry-run
